**How to submit:** Write on paper and show your steps; add the screenshot of Task 2. Upload a clear photo and the screenshot to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 2**.
You may use AI where a task says so. Check its work and say how you used it.

## Task 1 · The grid (2 marks)

The centre of a level is the origin; x goes right and y goes up. A key is 5
units left of the centre and 3 units down.

a) Write the position of the key and its quadrant. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The player is at (2, 4). Write the vector from the player to the key. Use
end − start. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · A patrol, with AI (3 marks)

::: {.callout-note .ai-task title="Task with AI · Plan a patrol"}
**Goal:** a patrol robot starts at (−6, 3) and must reach (6, −5) in exactly
4 frames, with one velocity per frame. Draw all its positions.

1. **Do it yourself:** find the velocity per frame by hand, and the position
   after 2 frames.
2. **Ask the AI:** start with this prompt.

   ::: {.prompt}
   Write GeoGebra commands that draw the 5 positions (frames 0 to 4) of a
   robot that starts at (−6, 3) and adds the same velocity every frame to
   reach (6, −5) after 4 frames. One command per line.
   :::

3. **Check:** draw the commands in geogebra.org/calculator. Is frame 2 where
   your hand result says? Is frame 4 at (6, −5)? Correct any wrong command.

*Submit:* your velocity and frame 2 (with steps), a screenshot of the
picture, and your AI-use statement: which tool, what you asked, what you
changed.
:::
